name: In the City / Q&A / Drinks, Tapas & Music / Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival
description:
Come to watch 𝙄𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘾𝙞𝙩𝙮 (“𝙀𝙣 𝙡𝙖 𝙘𝙞𝙪𝙙𝙖𝙙”) a mosaic-film by Cesc Gai that explores the lives, secrets, lies, loneliness and frustrations of a group of friends living in Barcelona 🏙️.

𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗠

🎞️ Screening of In the City with English subtitles.
After the film:
🎤 Short Q&A with scriptwriter Tomàs Aragay, moderated by Pau Guinart.
🍷🍻 Drinks and snacks courtesy of @moritzbarcelona, @azimutwines @melin_vin, and @torrafruitssecs.
🦜🎶 Electronic organic music by David Sitges-Sardà, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond.

𝗠𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢

Director: Cesc Gay
Length: 110 minutes
Language: Catalan, Spanish
Subtitles: English
Genre: comedy, drama

𝗦𝗬𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗦𝗜𝗦

Director Cesc Gay ('Truman’; Friends for Life') is a master of intelligent urban comedies. “In the city” depicts in a very elegant and subtle way the everyday lives of a group of eight friends in their 30s. Some secrets –and lies - are shared with friends, others are tackled in lonely frustration. Not to mention the dreams that go unaddressed, which ultimately set the tone for the meetings and conversations.

MORE INFO at filmfestival.catalans.dk & cinemateket.dk

name: SOLD OUT! Biutiful / Drinks, Tapas & Music / Dance Performance / Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival
description:
Come to the 𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗻 𝗙𝗶𝗹𝗺 𝗙𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗹 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰 with Mexican director Alejandro González Iñarritus masterpiece 𝘽𝙞𝙪𝙩𝙞𝙛𝙪𝙡, projected in 𝟯𝟱 𝗺𝗺. This multi-awarded film features Javier Bardem, who won best actor in Cannes, and portrays the 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗮. 🎞️

After the screening, there will be a 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗯𝘆 𝗤𝘂𝗶𝗺 𝗕𝗶𝗴𝗮𝘀 who will dance to the organic electronic soundscape of David Sitges-Sardà 🎵👣.

𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗠

🎬 Screening of Biutiful with Danish subtitles

After the film:
✨Dance improvisation by choreographer Quim Bigas.
🍷🍻 Drinks and snacks courtesy of @moritzbarcelona, @azimutwines @melin_vin, and @torrafruitssecs.
🦜🎶 Electronic organic music by David Sitges-Sardà, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond.

𝗠𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢

Director: Alejandro González Iñárritu
Length: 147 min.
Language: Spanish
Subtitles: Danish
Genre: drama

𝗦𝗬𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗦𝗜𝗦

Biutiful follows the story of a man in free fall. Uxbal, a separated father with two young children, lives in a profoundly precarious labor and social situation. In his struggle to survive and to improve the living conditions of his children, he is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Uxbal will attempt to rebuild his life at death's door.

MORE INFO at filmfestival.catalans.dk & cinemateket.dk

name: The Taxi Thief / Intro to ”Urgent cinema” / Q&A / Drinks, Tapas & Music
description:
Join us for the screening of 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙏𝙖𝙭𝙞 𝙏𝙝𝙞𝙚𝙛 (𝙀𝙡 𝙏𝙖𝙭𝙞𝙨𝙩𝙖 𝙁𝙪𝙡), a fake-documentary that follows unemployed Pepe and his struggles to make a living 💸. Directed by Jo Sol and inspired by real life events, the film was applauded both by the critic and the activists. 👏👏👏👏👏

𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗠

17:30 🎤 Intro to Urgent Cinema with director Jo Sol
18:00  🎞️ Screening of The Taxi Thief with English subtitles
after the film:
🎤 Short Q&A with director Jo Sol, moderated by Pau Guinart
🍷🍻Drinks and snacks courtesy of @moritzbarcelona, @azimutwines @melin_vin, and @torrafruitssecs. 
🦜🎶Electronic-organic music by David Sitges-Sardà, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond. 

𝗠𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢

Director: Jo Sol
Length: 90 min.
Language: Catalan, Spanish
Subtitles: English
Genre: comedy, drama, fake-documentary

𝗦𝗬𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗦𝗜𝗦

Pepe's night work is similar to that of most other taxi drivers, if it weren't for the fact that the taxis he drives are stolen. However, Pepe returns the cars at dawn and leaves part of the night's profits in them. Pepe's story (based on real-life events) has been hailed by activists for highlighting the precariat.

MORE INFO at filmfestival.catalans.dk & cinemateket.dk

name: The Long Way Home / Q&A / Drinks, Tapas & Music / Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival
description:
Wander the streets of Barcelona next to Joel in the 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗵𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗻 𝗙𝗶𝗹𝗺 𝗙𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗹 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰 with the screening of 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙇𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙒𝙖𝙮 𝙃𝙤𝙢𝙚  (El camí més llarg per tornar a casa) a multi-awarded feature film directed by Sergi Pérez and produced by Aritz Ciribán.👣 

𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗠

🎞️ Screening of The Long Way Home with English subtitles
After the film:
🎤Short Q&A with the producer Aritz Ciribán, moderated by Pau Guinart
🍷 Drinks and snacks courtesy of @moritzbarcelona, @azimutwines @melin_vin, and @torrafruitssecs
🎶Electronic-organic music by 🎶David Sitges-Sardà, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond. 

𝗠𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢

Director: Sergi Pérez
Length: 85 min.
Language: Catalan, Spanish
Subtitles: English
Genre: drama

𝗦𝗬𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗦𝗜𝗦

A familiar trip back home turns into a painful odyssey for Joel. On the day of his wife's funeral, Joel discovers his dog is sick. He heads to the vet carrying the dog in his arms but on his way out, forgets the keys inside. As he wanders erratically around the city, the plot slowly unravels what is really going on and why Joel desperately needs to return home. 

MORE INFO at filmfestival.catalans.dk & cinemateket.dk

name: SOLD OUT! Bajarí: Gypsy Barcelona / Q&A / Drinks, Tapas & Music / CCFF2024
description:
Discover the hidden corners of Barcelona under the tunes of rhythmical flamenco and the steps of flamencos-legend Karime Amaya 💃👠. Join us for the screening of 𝘽𝙖𝙟𝙖𝙧𝙞: 𝙂𝙮𝙥𝙨𝙮 𝘽𝙖𝙧𝙘𝙚𝙡𝙤𝙣𝙖 with the presence of director Eva Vila. 

𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗠

 🎞️Screening of Bajarí with English subtitles
after the film:
🎤 Short Q&A with director Eva Vila
🍷🍻Drinks and snacks courtesy of @Moritzbarcelona, @Azimutwines @Melin_vin and @torrafruitssecs
🦜🎶 Electronic organic music by David Sitges-Sardà, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond. 


𝗠𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢

Director: Eva Vila
Length: 90 min.
Language: Catalan, Spanish
Subtitles: English
Genre: documentary, musical

𝗦𝗬𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗦𝗜𝗦

'Bajarí' (Barcelona in the Caló language) vividly and sensitively portrays the gypsy culture in Barcelona. We explore with a 5-year-old boy who dreams of becoming a bailaor (flamenco dancer), and with young dancer Karime Amaya, who has a new show to carry on the legacy of her famous relative - the flamenco legend of them all - Carmen Amaya. A must-see for flamenco fans!

MORE INFO at filmfestival.catalans.dk & cinemateket.dk

name: Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival 2024: The Other Barcelona
description:
𝗗𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗹𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗮? ✨🌊

Embark on a cinematographic tour of this wonderful city together with the Catalan Film Festival 2024 and its 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘀𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗺𝘀 🙌🏻.
From the 𝟰𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟲𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗔𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗹 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰, we will be screening at the @Cinemateket five feature films that depict diverse realities of Barcelona. All films will be followed by a 𝗤&𝗔 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗺 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝘄 🎤; 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗻 𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗯𝗲𝗲𝗿𝘀 courtesy of @azimutwines, @moritz and @melinvin 🍷🍻; and an 𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗶𝗰-𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗽𝗲 by artist David Sitges-Sardà 🦜🎶, who collects and remixes sounds from the mountains surrounding Barcelona and beyond. To round-off the festival, choreographer Quim Bigas will offer a 𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲.

Don’t miss out on this unique chance to discover 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙊𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙧 𝘽𝙖𝙧𝙘𝙚𝙡𝙤𝙣𝙖! 🔎

More information about the program below and in our website filmfestival.catalans.dk/
